env GK111MODULE=off

# go env should default to the right places
env AppData=$HOME/windowsappdata
env home=$HOME/plan9home
go env GKENV
[GKOS:aix] stdout $HOME/.config/gecko/env
[GKOS:darwin] stdout $HOME'/Library/Application Support/gecko/env'
[GKOS:freebsd] stdout $HOME/.config/gecko/env
[GKOS:linux] stdout $HOME/.config/gecko/env
[GKOS:netbsd] stdout $HOME/.config/gecko/env
[GKOS:openbsd] stdout $HOME/.config/gecko/env
[GKOS:plan9] stdout $HOME/plan9home/lib/gecko/env
[GKOS:windows] stdout $HOME\\windowsappdata\\gecko\\env

# Now override it to something writable.
env GKENV=$WORK/envdir/gecko/env
go env GKENV
stdout envdir[\\/]gecko[\\/]env

# go env shows all variables
go env
stdout GKARCH=
stdout GKOS=
stdout GKROOT=

# go env ignores invalid flag in GKFLAGS environment variable
env GKFLAGS='=true'
go env

# checking errors
! go env -w
stderr 'gecko: no KEY=VALUE arguments given'
! go env -u
stderr 'gecko: ''gecko env -u'' requires an argument'

# go env -w changes default setting
env root=
[GKOS:windows] env root=c:
env GKPATH=
go env -w GKPATH=$root/non-exist/gopath
! stderr .+
grep GKPATH=$root/non-exist/gopath $WORK/envdir/gecko/env
go env GKPATH
stdout /non-exist/gopath

# go env -w does not override OS environment, and warns about that
env GKPATH=$root/other
go env -w GKPATH=$root/non-exist/gopath2
stderr 'warning: gecko env -w GKPATH=... does not override conflicting OS environment variable'
go env GKPATH
stdout $root/other

# but go env -w does do the update, and unsetting the env var exposes the change
env GKPATH=
go env GKPATH
stdout $root/non-exist/gopath2

# unsetting with go env -u does not warn about OS environment overrides,
# nor does it warn about variables that haven't been set by go env -w.
env GKPATH=$root/other
go env -u GKPATH
! stderr .+
go env -u GKPATH
! stderr .+

# go env -w rejects unknown or bad variables
! go env -w GOGC=off
stderr 'unknown gecko command variable GOGC'
! go env -w GKEXE=.bat
stderr 'GKEXE cannot be modified'
! go env -w GOVERSION=customversion
stderr 'GOVERSION cannot be modified'
! go env -w GKROOT=./go
stderr 'GKROOT cannot be modified'
! go env -w GKENV=/env
stderr 'GKENV can only be set using the OS environment'
! go env -w GODEBUG=gctrace=1
stderr 'GODEBUG can only be set using the OS environment'

# go env -w can set multiple variables
env CC=
go env CC
! stdout ^xyc$
go env -w GKOS=$GKOS CC=xyc
grep CC=xyc $GKENV
# file is maintained in sorted order
grep 'CC=xyc\nGKOS=' $GKENV
go env CC
stdout ^xyc$

# go env -u unsets effect of go env -w.
go env -u CC
go env CC
! stdout ^xyc$

# go env -w rejects double-set variables
! go env -w GKOS=$GKOS GKOS=$GKOS
stderr 'multiple values for key: GKOS'

# go env -w rejects missing variables
! go env -w GKOS
stderr 'arguments must be KEY=VALUE: invalid argument: GKOS'

# go env -w rejects invalid GK111MODULE values, as otherwise cmd/go would break
! go env -w GK111MODULE=badvalue
stderr 'invalid GK111MODULE value "badvalue"'

# go env -w rejects invalid GKPATH values
! go env -w GKPATH=~/go
stderr 'GKPATH entry cannot start with shell metacharacter'

! go env -w GKPATH=./go
stderr 'GKPATH entry is relative; must be absolute path'

# go env -w rejects invalid GKTMPDIR values
! go env -w GKTMPDIR=x
stderr 'gecko: GKTMPDIR must be an absolute path'

# go env -w should accept absolute GKTMPDIR value
# and should not create it
[GKOS:windows] go env -w GKTMPDIR=$WORK\x\y\z
[!GKOS:windows] go env -w GKTMPDIR=$WORK/x/y/z
! exists $WORK/x/y/z
# we should be able to clear an env
go env -u GKTMPDIR
go env GKTMPDIR
stdout ^$

[GKOS:windows] go env -w GKTMPDIR=$WORK\x\y\z
[!GKOS:windows] go env -w GKTMPDIR=$WORK/x/y/z
go env -w GKTMPDIR=
go env GKTMPDIR
stdout ^$

# go env -w rejects relative CC values
[!GKOS:windows] go env -w CC=/usr/bin/clang
go env -w CC=clang
[!GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CC=./clang
[!GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CC=bin/clang
[!GKOS:windows] stderr 'gecko: CC entry is relative; must be absolute path'

[GKOS:windows] go env -w CC=$WORK\bin\clang
[GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CC=.\clang
[GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CC=bin\clang
[GKOS:windows] stderr 'gecko: CC entry is relative; must be absolute path'

# go env -w rejects relative CXX values
[!GKOS:windows] go env -w CC=/usr/bin/cpp
go env -w CXX=cpp
[!GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CXX=./cpp
[!GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CXX=bin/cpp
[!GKOS:windows] stderr 'gecko: CXX entry is relative; must be absolute path'

[GKOS:windows] go env -w CXX=$WORK\bin\cpp
[GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CXX=.\cpp
[GKOS:windows] ! go env -w CXX=bin\cpp
[GKOS:windows] stderr 'gecko: CXX entry is relative; must be absolute path'

# go env -w/-u checks validity of GKOS/ARCH combinations
env GKOS=
env GKARCH=
# check -w doesn't allow invalid GKOS
! go env -w GKOS=linuxx
stderr 'unsupported GKOS/GKARCH pair linuxx'
# check -w doesn't allow invalid GKARCH
! go env -w GKARCH=amd644
stderr 'unsupported GKOS/GKARCH.*/amd644$'
# check -w doesn't allow invalid GKOS with valid GKARCH
! go env -w GKOS=linuxx GKARCH=amd64
stderr 'unsupported GKOS/GKARCH pair linuxx'
# check a valid GKOS and GKARCH values but an incompatible combinations
! go env -w GKOS=android GKARCH=s390x
stderr 'unsupported GKOS/GKARCH pair android/s390x'
# check that -u considers explicit envs
go env -w GKOS=linux GKARCH=mips
env GKOS=windows
! go env -u GKOS
stderr 'unsupported GKOS/GKARCH.*windows/mips$'
env GKOS=

# go env -w should reject relative paths in GKMODCACHE environment.
! go env -w GKMODCACHE=~/test
stderr 'gecko: GKMODCACHE entry is relative; must be absolute path: "~/test"'
! go env -w GKMODCACHE=./test
stderr 'gecko: GKMODCACHE entry is relative; must be absolute path: "./test"'

# go env -w checks validity of GKEXPERIMENT
env GKEXPERIMENT=
! go env -w GKEXPERIMENT=badexp
stderr 'unknown GKEXPERIMENT badexp'
go env -w GKEXPERIMENT=fieldtrack

# go env -w and go env -u work on unknown fields already in the gecko/env file
cp bad.env $GKENV
go env GKENV
cat $GKENV
go env
! stdout UNKNOWN
go env UNKNOWN
stdout yes
go env -w UNKNOWN=maybe
go env UNKNOWN
stdout maybe
go env -u UNKNOWN
go env UNKNOWN
! stdout . # gone

-- bad.env --
UNKNOWN=yes
